# Adeel Builds

> Adeel Builds is a web design service run by Muhammad Adeel Tariq for UK salons, aesthetics clinics and barbershops. Every project starts with a free homepage mockup; the deposit is due only after the client approves the design, and the balance only if they love the finished site. Websites go live within 14 days of approval.

## About

[Adeel Builds](https://www.adeelmalik.dev/#about) is run by Muhammad Adeel Tariq. The service focuses on web design for UK salons, aesthetics clinics and barbershops.

## Services and prices

[Starter](https://www.adeelmalik.dev/#prices) costs £70 fixed. It includes a one-page site, booking built in, reviews and prices, and Google Business Profile tidy-up.

[Growth](https://www.adeelmalik.dev/#prices) costs £100 fixed. It includes a multi-page site, service and price pages, review showcase, and WhatsApp booking button.

The [optional care plan](https://www.adeelmalik.dev/#prices) costs £39/month. There is no contract, and clients can cancel anytime.

## How it works

[Every Adeel Builds project](https://www.adeelmalik.dev/#offer) starts with a free homepage mockup. The deposit is due only after the client approves the design, and the balance only if they love the finished site. The website goes live within 14 days of approval.

Clients keep their existing Treatwell, Fresha, Booksy, Square or Setmore booking. The website adds direct bookings alongside the existing booking platform.

## Marketplace commission comparison

[The marketplace comparison](https://www.adeelmalik.dev/#maths) uses Treatwell's published 35% + VAT charge on a new client's first booking and Fresha's published 20% one-time new-client fee. An own website charges 0% commission on direct bookings.

## FAQ

[Frequently asked questions](https://www.adeelmalik.dev/#faq):

### Do I have to leave Treatwell or Fresha?

No. Your booking stays exactly where it is, built into your new site. The site simply gives clients a way to book you directly too.

### What if I don't like the design?

Then you pay nothing. The deposit is only due after you approve the mockup, and the balance only when you love the finished site.

### How long does it take?

14 days from the day you approve the mockup.

### Do I own the website?

Yes. The domain is registered in your name and the site is yours. No lock-in, no renting.

### What does it cost after launch?

Nothing is required. Most clients take the £39/month care plan for hosting and updates, but it is monthly and cancel-anytime.
